import sys
import pandera.pandas as pa
import hamilton.driver as driver
from hamilton_sdk import adapters
from hamilton.function_modifiers import check_output
import pandas as pd
from motor_learning_network.constants import (
    DEFAULT_UI_PROJECT_ID,
    DEFAULT_UI_USERNAME,
    TEAM_NAME,
    FIGURES_PATH,
    PROCESSED_DATA_PATH,
)
from pathlib import Path
from hamilton.io.materialization import from_, to

# Constants
CURRENT_FILE_NAME = Path(__file__).stem
UI_CONFIG = adapters.HamiltonTracker(
    project_id=DEFAULT_UI_PROJECT_ID,
    username=DEFAULT_UI_USERNAME,
    dag_name=CURRENT_FILE_NAME,
    tags={"environment": "DEV", "team": TEAM_NAME, "version": "0.1"},
)


def main() -> int:
    inputs = dict(schema=dict(""))
    input_files = [
        from_.parquet(target="scopus_df",path=PROCESSED_DATA_PATH / "merged_WOS_database.parquet"),
        from_.parquet(target="wos_df",path=PROCESSED_DATA_PATH / "merged_EBSCO_database.parquet"),
        from_.parquet(target="pubmed_df",path=PROCESSED_DATA_PATH / "merged_Scopus_database.parquet"),
        from_.parquet(target="ebsco_df",path=PROCESSED_DATA_PATH / "merged_WOS_database.parquet"),
    ]
    outputs = []
    import __main__

    dr = (
        driver.Builder()
        .with_modules(__main__)
        .with_adapters(UI_CONFIG)
        .with_materializers(*input_files)
        .build()
    )
    dr.validate_execution(outputs, inputs=inputs)
    dr.display_all_functions(
        FIGURES_PATH / f"{CURRENT_FILE_NAME}_all_functions.png",
        keep_dot=True,
        deduplicate_inputs=True,
    )
    dr.visualize_execution(
        outputs,
        inputs=inputs,
        output_file_path=FIGURES_PATH / f"{CURRENT_FILE_NAME}_execution_diagram.png",
        keep_dot=True,
        deduplicate_inputs=True,
    )
    # dr.execute(outputs, inputs=inputs)
    return 0

def merged_dataframes(
    scopus_df: pd.DataFrame,
    wos_df: pd.DataFrame,
    pubmed_df: pd.DataFrame,
    ebsco_df: pd.DataFrame,
    schema: pa.DataFrameSchema,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    scopus_df = scopus_df[schema.columns]
    wos_df = wos_df[schema.columns]
    pubmed_df = pubmed_df[schema.columns]
    ebsco_df = ebsco_df[schema.columns]
    schema.validate(scopus_df)
    schema.validate(wos_df)
    schema.validate(pubmed_df)
    schema.validate(ebsco_df)
    merged_dataframes = pd.concat(scopus_df, wos_df, pubmed_df, ebsco_df)    
    return merged_dataframes

if  __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
